_doc: Read by run_conformance.py (build.ps1 -Smoke, default-mode session). Every scenario the pinned suite runs is listed once: pass (passes today; a failure fails the smoke step), known_failures (a defect a later card fixes: card, the failing check ids, why) or not_applicable (needs something NodeToCode does not offer: the failing check ids, why). A check outside an entry's checks fails the smoke step; a listed scenario that passes prints NOW PASSES, and the owning card moves it to pass in its own commit. An optional engines list limits an entry to some engine labels. known_failures['inspector tools/list'] matches the Inspector's error text with the regex in match. known_warnings maps '<scenario>/<check id>' WARNING checks to the card that owns them (warnings never fail). Raising a pin: run the new version against 5.6, 5.7 and 5.8 and classify every new scenario.

logging-set-level.why: initialize advertises the logging capability but logging/setLevel is not implemented (-32601). Card 0110 stops advertising logging (deprecated in 2026-07-28); the scenario then moves to not_applicable.

inspector tools/list.why: Inspector 2.x sends logging/setLevel right after initialize because the server advertises logging, gets -32601 and exits before tools/list. Passes once card 0110 drops the logging capability; the smoke step then checks the tool count.

completion-complete.why: The server does not advertise the completions capability, so -32601 for completion/complete is correct.

resources-subscribe.why: The server advertises resources.subscribe false; resources/subscribe is not offered.

resources-unsubscribe.why: The server advertises resources.subscribe false; resources/unsubscribe is not offered.
